families.name: Seal
families.text: Its marks are not shed.

families.name: Lead
families.text: Helps the next creature in its row after it marks.

families.name: Heavy Prime
families.text: Gives up its damage for more mark stacks (Setters only).

families.name: Self Prime
families.text: A non-Setter that marks what it can cash.

families.name: Guard Prime
families.text: A Guard that marks, at a cost to its Guard role (P-02).

families.name: Support Prime
families.text: A Support that marks instead of its boost and heal.

families.name: Detonator
families.text: A Payoff that spends several stacks.

families.name: Chain
families.text: After a reaction, leaves a mark of its own element.

families.name: Punish the clear
families.text: Strikes back when the boss clears what is on it.

families.name: Flurry
families.text: Several smaller hits.

families.name: Reach
families.text: Changes how far a Guard covers.

families.name: Intercept
families.text: Changes which hits it takes for others (a non-Guard only when no Guard can).

families.name: Taunt
families.text: Draws the plain attack.

families.name: Evasion
families.text: Its own dodge, with Retaliate or a Store.

families.name: Evasion aura
families.text: Dodge for the creatures beside it or in its row (the largest aura applies).

families.name: Row Ward
families.text: Cuts area damage for its row or the creatures beside it (the largest applies).

families.name: Silence Guard
families.text: Keeps the creatures beside it from being silenced.

families.name: Pierce
families.text: Ignores some boss armour.

families.name: Luck
families.text: Trades hit size for crits, or takes the sting out of a boss crit.

families.name: Partner
families.text: A bonus on its hits while a given role is, or is not, beside it.

families.name: Support shape
families.text: Changes where a Support's boost and heal land, or replaces them.

families.name: Sustain
families.text: Heals, on a reaction or at round start.

families.name: Store
families.text: Fills over the fight, spends at 3.

families.name: Debuff
families.text: Puts a debuff on the boss.

families.name: Signature
families.text: An epic's own twist on a family, on one species only.

knacks.name: Brand
knacks.text: {Seal}: its marks are not shed by the boss.
knacks.intent: Answers bosses that shed marks on their turns (Clean Scales), which matter now that the boss acts after every row.

knacks.name: Backlash
knacks.text: When the boss sheds a {Mark}, it strikes back for 20% of its Attack, ignoring armour. Once a round.
knacks.intent: Answers marks that are shed (Clean Scales) without a Seal: an unsealed Setter's mark can cross a boss turn, and the Payoff punishes the clearing. A counter, not a hit: no crit, it ignores armour and dodge. It fires once a round per creature, on the first shed, however many marks or stacks go, so copies and Heavy Prime stacks do not pile it up. It stays below Brand on every stack of cards measured.

knacks.name: Lead the Way
knacks.text: After it leaves a mark, the next creature to act in its row gets +20% on that hit.
knacks.intent: Rewards placing the Payoff right after the Setter in a row.

knacks.name: Pin Down
knacks.text: After it leaves a {Mark}, the boss cannot dodge the next creature to act in its row this round.
knacks.intent: Answers dodge (Elusive, Slippery): the Setter's hit may miss, its mark still lands, and the hit after it cannot. It trades away Lead the Way's boost and Brand's Seal, so the Setter's pick is a real choice. One flag, cleared every round, so copies do not stack.

knacks.name: Feed the Marks
knacks.text: Its hit deals no damage. It leaves its {Mark} and adds 1 stack to every other mark on the boss.
knacks.intent: For multi-mark teams and Payoffs that spend several stacks.

knacks.name: Returning Tide
knacks.text: Each reaction on a Tide mark heals the creature that set it off by 14% of its max HP.
knacks.intent: Keeps Payoffs alive when reactions hurt them (Reflective Hide, Thorns).

knacks.name: Self-Starter
knacks.text: When it sets off no {Reaction}, it leaves the mark it can cash, like a Setter.
knacks.intent: A Payoff that works without a Setter, at half the pace.

knacks.name: All In
knacks.text: Cashes only a mark at 3 stacks, and {Spend}s all of them.
knacks.intent: Misa's mark-mark-mark-big-payoff choice: a slow, huge hit that breaks armour.

knacks.name: Leave a Trail
knacks.text: After its {Reaction}, it leaves 1 stack of its element's mark. That mark's reaction leaves no trail.
knacks.intent: Cross-element chains: a reaction primes the next one for another Payoff.

knacks.name: Detonate
knacks.text: {Spend}s all the stacks of the mark it cashes. Weak on 1 stack, strong on 2 or 3.
knacks.intent: Pays off two Setters, or a Setter with Heavy Prime; worse than no Knack on a single stack.

knacks.name: Aftershock
knacks.text: {Spend}s all stacks of the mark it cashes, for less than Detonate. A hit cap splits its hit and bonus.
knacks.intent: The Detonator's answer to a hit cap (Stone Skin): the reaction's bonus lands as a second hit, each held to the cap on its own. Its bonus is 90% of Detonate's, so on a boss with no cap Detonate is still the better pick.

knacks.name: Twin Strike
knacks.text: Hits twice, each for 58%. Each hit can set off a reaction.
knacks.intent: Weaker in a plain fight; answers bosses that cap single hits or dodge a lot. Poor against armour.

knacks.name: Clear Skies
knacks.text: Instead of its boost and heal: the boss cannot dodge the hits of creatures {Beside} it this round.
knacks.intent: Answers Elusive bosses.

knacks.name: Clear the Air
knacks.text: Creatures beside it that set off a reaction heal 10% and lose their silence.
knacks.intent: Answers Reflective Hide, Thorns and silence on the Payoff.

knacks.name: Eye of the Storm
knacks.text: {Store} Calm: +1 per reaction anywhere. At 3 at round start: creatures beside it get +45%, spends all.
knacks.intent: A reaction-heavy line gets a burst every few rounds.

knacks.name: Wide Reach
knacks.text: Its reach is +1 slot on each side.
knacks.intent: Protects fragile creatures two slots away; strong in wide raid rows.

knacks.name: Primed by Pain
knacks.text: Each time it {Intercept}s, it leaves 2 stacks of its own element's mark. Once a round.
knacks.intent: A Guard that marks by taking hits (panel 5: once a fight, and one stack, was too little to build a team on): an Ember Payoff gets its reaction while the Setter slot becomes another hitter.

knacks.name: Night Watch
knacks.text: Each boss turn it {Intercept}s the first {Wind-up} hit in its row, taking a quarter of it.
knacks.intent: Answers telegraphed big hits (Wild Sweep, Judgement Bolt). One hit a boss turn, and the hit it takes is cut to a quarter (the most any cut can take), so it is no longer a liability (panel 4; 2026-10-31: the cover cut of 40% left it tied with no Knack outside Wild Sweep and behind Primed by Pain on it).

knacks.name: Sunbeam
knacks.text: Instead of the creatures beside it, it heals and boosts every creature in front of it in its column.
knacks.intent: Uses the whole board: healers belong at the back. Bosses that hit the back row punish it.

knacks.name: Curl Up
knacks.text: Its heal on a creature below half HP is tripled.
knacks.intent: For steady damage on a Guard.

knacks.name: Stack Up
knacks.text: Instead of its boost and heal: it adds 1 stack to its own element's {Mark}.
knacks.intent: Lets a team without a Setter react; needs a Payoff of the right element.

knacks.name: Wide Embrace
knacks.text: Its boost also reaches one slot further on each side, at full strength.
knacks.intent: Wide rows with several hitters: a Support at the end of a line of three boosts both hitters, and in a raid row it reaches the far column too. Tar Leech asks for it.

knacks.name: Sense Weakness
knacks.text: Hits by creatures beside it ignore half the boss's armour.
knacks.intent: Answers armoured bosses for plain hitters.

knacks.name: Find the Gap
knacks.text: Its own hits ignore a third of the boss's armour.
knacks.intent: Pierce for a Payoff of a common species: its own plain and reaction hits get past thick bark (Thornmother, Tar Leech), where Sense Weakness helps the creatures beside a Support. Only the Payoff's hits, so it is a choice for one creature, not a row.

knacks.name: Draw Fire
knacks.text: {Taunt}. Armour +15.
knacks.intent: Takes the plain attacks off fragile creatures wherever they stand.

knacks.name: Barricade
knacks.text: While it stands, its row takes 15% less from area and {Wind-up} hits.
knacks.intent: Protects other players' creatures in its row in the raid.

knacks.name: Boiling Point
knacks.text: {Store} Heat: +1 per round and per hit in its {Reach}. At 3, next {Reaction} beside it deals double bonus.
knacks.intent: A Guard beside a Payoff in a hard fight.

knacks.name: Zoom
knacks.text: +20 dodge. When it dodges, it hits back for 50% of its Attack ({Retaliate}).
knacks.intent: A Setter that survives and adds damage when the boss hits often.

knacks.name: Double Mark
knacks.text: Its hit deals no damage. It leaves its {Mark} at 2 stacks.
knacks.intent: Feeds Detonators and two Payoffs of the trigger element.

knacks.name: Zigzag
knacks.text: {Taunt}, +12 dodge. {Store} Static: +1 per dodge; at 3, its next mark gets +1 stack.
knacks.intent: A dodge tank beside a Guard (dodge before intercept).

knacks.name: Take It All
knacks.text: It {Intercept}s area hits too, and takes them with its cover's cut.
knacks.intent: Answers sweeps and splashes. 2026-10-31: it used to take the whole area hit with no cut, which left it worse than no Knack on Wild Sweep; the cover cut makes it the pick against sweeps.

knacks.name: Drop Guard
knacks.text: It leaves its own element's {Mark} like a Setter, but it does not {Intercept}, and Armour -8.
knacks.intent: A Setter that survives the front row; it pays with the Guard's verb and its armour (P-02: never a Setter and a Guard in one body).

knacks.name: Sticky Mud
knacks.text: Each hit it takes, even Blocked, puts {Mired} x1 on the boss.
knacks.intent: Keeps Mire's debuff alive after finale abilities go.

knacks.name: Squelch Song
knacks.text: At round start the boss gains {Mired} x1.
knacks.intent: Keeps Mire's debuff alive after finale abilities go.

knacks.name: Reliably Covered
knacks.text: +10% on its hits while a living Guard stands beside it. Armour -10.
knacks.intent: A Payoff that wants a Guard partner, ideally another player's in the raid. Named Guard's Shadow until 2026-11-01; the gear line Guard's shadow keeps that name.

knacks.name: Crown of Embers
knacks.text: Each {Mark} it leaves adds 2 stacks, and its hit still deals damage.
knacks.intent: Solmane's signature: an epic Setter that feeds Detonators without giving up its damage.

knacks.name: Mist Veil
knacks.text: Creatures beside it get +15 dodge.
knacks.intent: A Guard that protects by hiding friends; strong with dodge-before-intercept (R1) when the boss hits often.

knacks.name: Rolling Fog
knacks.text: Every creature in its row gets +8 dodge.
knacks.intent: The wide version for long raid rows.

knacks.name: Drizzle
knacks.text: Instead of its boost and heal: it heals every creature in its row (itself too) by 5% of max HP.
knacks.intent: A row healer for long raid rows and steady damage.

knacks.name: Living Shelter
knacks.text: Creatures beside it take 25% less from {Area hit}s.
knacks.intent: Ancientshell hosts small creatures: a Setter that shelters its neighbours from sweeps.

knacks.name: Territorial
knacks.text: +30% on its hits while no other living Payoff stands beside it.
knacks.intent: Coralynx guards its reef alone: a placement question its owner controls (beside, not the whole row, so other players cannot switch it off).

knacks.name: Unlikely Guardian
knacks.text: {Intercept}s aimed hits for the creatures {Beside} it when no Guard can. Reaction bonus -25%.
knacks.intent: Gaiadrake protects everything it carries: a Payoff borrowing the Guard's verb at a cost (P-02).

knacks.name: Starlight
knacks.text: Instead of its boost and heal: it {Boost}s every other creature in its row by 10%.
knacks.intent: Aurorix looks after friends from a distance: a row-wide boost for long raid rows.

knacks.name: Lantern Glow
knacks.text: Creatures beside it cannot be {Silenced}.
knacks.intent: Lanternfin guides friends through the dark: the silence answer that protects others.

knacks.name: Hearth
knacks.text: At round start it heals the creatures in its {Reach} by 6% of max HP.
knacks.intent: Hearthshell hosts friends around its fire: a Guard that heals the creatures it protects.

knacks.name: Wild Swing
knacks.text: Its hit deals 25% less, but it has +20 crit chance points and its {Crit}s get +0.5x.
knacks.intent: A crit machine: a softer plain hit that crits often, so it stacks with Crit Chance, Amplified Crits and a crit species. The wrong pick against a boss that caps a hit (Stone Skin) or one that Blocks small hits, and where a steady hit matters more than swing.

knacks.name: Cool Head
knacks.text: {Crit}s on it and creatures {Beside} it deal no extra damage; a spared crit stores a {Sure Crit} there.
knacks.intent: The answer to a boss that crits (Double Strike): a Guard that keeps a crit to a plain hit for itself and its neighbours, and turns each spared crit into a Sure Crit for the creature it was aimed at, so it asks for a Payoff beside the Guard. A Sure Crit deals the spender's own crit extra (a Perfect Timing creature's is 3x). Nothing against a boss that never crits (2026-10-31: at half the ward alone was tied with no Knack on every card but Double Strike).
